text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘Road Safety’ (सड़क पर सावधानी)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘Road Safety’ (Sadak par saavdhani). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘Road Safety’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘cross’ मतलब पार करना। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘cross’ matlab paar karna. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘cross’ means पार करना. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘signal’ मतलब सिग्नल। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘signal’ matlab signal. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘signal’ means सिग्नल. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘helmet’ मतलब हेलमेट। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘helmet’ matlab helmet. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘helmet’ means हेलमेट. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: Look right, look left, then look right again.
Cross the road only at the zebra crossing.
When you ride a bicycle, wear a helmet.
Keep to the left side of the road.
Do not look at a phone while walking on the road.

question.en: Where should you cross the road?

question.hi: साइकिल चलाते समय क्या पहनना चाहिए?
question.hinglish: Cycle chalate samay kya pehnna chahiye?
question.en: What should you wear when you ride a bicycle?
